title: Due-date range remains stale after organization-local midnight rejection
head: 5af47b7c9b02af34506b89ea7b29bb84b1a2b1c4
scenario: M-05 browser/server policy-date parity at Asia/Taipei midnight
personas: Mei / Project Manager, synthetic Horizon tenant
reproduction: Open an unexpired review proposal at organization time 23:59:59 with due date set to that day's valid minimum.
Keep the review open; advance only the isolated application clock one second to Asia/Taipei 00:00:00.
Explicitly confirm. The server rejects the now-yesterday due date with INVALID_DUE_DATE.
Observe that input min/max and the displayed date hint remain yesterday's range; error instructs a date within that same stale displayed range.
GET the same proposal through the actual API: it returns today's current bounds while the open form still shows the old bounds.
expected: The error/recovery view communicates the current authoritative date range and preserves the complete draft; displayed bounds agree with the server at retry. Invalid confirmation creates no business record.
acceptanceCriteria: Browser/server derive the same effective Asia/Taipei policy date after crossing midnight
Error hint and min/max refresh from server authority without losing draft
classification: Required-path P2 presentation/recovery defect; server enforcement and write containment remain correct. No observed P0/P1.

sourceCause.server: internal-review-service.ts calculates current bounds on proposal reads and validates against current clock on confirm; VALIDATION_FAILED returns fieldErrors only.
sourceCause.client: internal-review-sheet.tsx retains original proposal.minDueDate/maxDueDate after VALIDATION_FAILED; only failure and fieldErrors change.

classificationReview: Primary evaluator classification backed by bilingual browser/HTTP/database evidence; independent repair/contract review not yet performed.
repairScopeCandidate: Refresh authoritative bounds after due-date validation failure, retaining the complete draft, error association and focus. Add server/component midnight regression coverage. No policy threshold/auth/tenant/schema change justified.
